messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the Rate Limiter postmortem. We need final owners + short timelines for customer-facing comms and to capture recurring-pattern language. Items: status page blurb, 72h public summary, and RCA access/redaction policy. Who picks up what?

ben: I can own the status page blurb. Will produce a 1-line TL;DR + one "what we're doing" bullet. Draft by 2026-03-27 EOD and will paste here for a quick tone check.

liz: I will co-own the 72h external summary with Jordan. I'll focus on tone and legal redactions. Plan: include an impact matrix and a single POC. Due 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC.

sam: I'll take the RCA sharing policy work. Deliverables: redaction checklist, consent form language, and an access list matrix (who gets detailed RCAs). Target: 2026-03-25 COB. Note: Legal asked for no customer-identifying screenshots in any shared doc.

jordan: I'll run the recurring-pattern short analysis and attach a one-paragraph mitigation plan for the 72h summary. I see two similar routing-policy regressions in the last 90 days; recommend scheduling a routing-policy audit. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: I added these to the postmortem action tracker. Please surface exact deliverables in the tracker and make sure the POC is incidents@redwood.com. Initial action snippet I added: ```- Status page blurb  owner: ben  due: 2026-03-27 EOD
- 72h external summary  owners: liz, jordan  due: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC
- RCA sharing policy + consent flow  owner: sam  due: 2026-03-25 COB
- Remediation rollout update  owner: eng-sre  due: 2026-04-02```

ben: Draft status copy: "We experienced a brief period of request throttling due to a misapplied quota routing rule. Impact: a small subset of requests for a short window. Mitigation: traffic reroute and hotfix deployed. Next steps: permanent routing guard and improved monitoring. POC: incidents@redwood.com." Keeping it high level per legal.

liz: Suggestion: replace "short window" with "brief period" and add a link to the live status page. Add a two-line "what we're doing to prevent recurrence" section.

sam: Consent language note: propose a one-click checkbox + email request; default is redacted public summary. For impacted customers we can provide a detailed timeline after consent; do not include unredacted customer IDs. I'll draft the form now.

sre-bot: Postmortem filed: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1. Action tracker entry created.

maria: Thanks all. I'll create calendar nudges 24h before due dates and run a short weekly follow-up on recurring patterns until remediation is closed. If anyone needs to swap, reply here.
